model_outputs:

Since G is a directed graph, every vertex has at least one outgoing edge, so there is no vertex with no outgoing edge. This means that statement II is false.
Since G is a directed graph, there is no vertex with no edges, so there is no isolated vertex. This means that statement III is false.
The answer is (H).
